name: ASOF_VALUE
parameter_policy: No hidden defaults; source/PIT policy determines selection

name: LAGGED_LAST
input_semantics: Most recent eligible prior observation strictly before target cutoff
notes: No same-game output may enter pregame row.

name: ROLLING_MEAN_COUNT
parameter_policy: N is experiment parameter; no universal window

name: ROLLING_STD_COUNT
input_semantics: Dispersion over trailing eligible prior observations

name: EWMA
parameter_policy: alpha/half-life is experiment parameter; no hard-coded universal value

name: LINEAR_TREND
input_semantics: Slope across ordered eligible prior observations
notes: Trend is descriptive candidate, not automatic strength signal.

name: PRIOR_CHANGE
input_semantics: Difference between latest and prior eligible observations

name: RATE_PER_OPPORTUNITY
input_semantics: Eligible numerator divided by eligible exposure/opportunity
parameter_policy: denominator semantics and zero policy explicit

name: OPPONENT_ADJUSTED_RESIDUAL
input_semantics: Observed eligible performance minus context/opponent expectation built only from prior-safe state

name: MATCHUP_DIFFERENCE
input_semantics: PIT-safe team strength/skill minus PIT-safe opponent counterpart

name: MATCHUP_PRODUCT
input_semantics: Interaction of two independently PIT-safe inputs
parameter_policy: interaction explicitly registered; combinatorial generation prohibited
notes: Interactions must earn value; no brute-force explosion.

name: MISSINGNESS_INDICATOR
input_semantics: Indicator derived from PIT-safe missingness/coverage state
notes: Missingness may be informative but can encode source/era artifacts; must be tested.

name: HIERARCHICAL_PRIOR_BLEND
input_semantics: Blend sparse subgroup value with broader prior using PIT-safe evidence
parameter_policy: weighting method learned/validated later; no fixed shrinkage constant in W10
notes: Useful for sparse teams/players but W11+ owns concrete state models.
